05.04.2021 CRMA No. 1568 of 2019
In
CRLR No. 334 of 2019
Hon’ble R.C. Khulbe, J.
Ms. Prabha Naithani, learned 
counsel for the revisionist.
Ms. Sonika Khulbe, learned Brief 
Holder for the State.
Mr. Naveen Bisht, learned 
counsel holding brief of Mr. Lalit 
Sharma, learned counsel for the 
private respondent.
This revision is preferred against 
the judgment and order dated 
27.11.2018, passed by Judge, Family 
Court, Udham Singh Nagar in criminal 
case no. 252 of 2015, Smt. Vimlesh 
Kumari Vs. Suresh Singh whereby the 
learned court has rejected the 
application filed under section 125 
Cr.P.C.
The revision is time barred. 
Accordingly, delay condonation 
application has been moved, which is 
supported by an affidavit.
Sufficient ground has been 
shown.
Respondent no. 2 has no 
objection.
Accordingly, delay condonation 
application is allowed. The delay in 
filing the revision is condoned.
Admit the revision.
Summon the LCR.
It is submitted that there are 
chances of settlement between the 
parties. Hence, the parties are  directed to appear before the 
Mediation Centre, Kashipur, Udham 
Singh Nagar on 27.04.2021 for 
mediation.
List thereafter.
 
 (R.C. Khulbe, J.)
 05.04.2021 Parul
